name: PM Vishwakarma Yojana
summary: Support for traditional artisans and craftsmen — training, tools, and loans
hindi_summary: Paramparik karigar aur shilpkaron ko training, auzaar, aur loan ki suvidha
benefits: Free skill training, ₹15,000 toolkit, loan up to ₹3 lakh at 5%, PM Vishwakarma certificate
eligibility: Traditional artisans — lohar, kumhar, sunar, darzi, nai, mali, etc.
